profile.headline: Software Engineer at U.S. Bank
profile.summary: I am currently a Rotational Engineer working at US Bank full-time. Experience with managing and coordinating projects and activities. Self driven and able to use resources to meet deadlines with minimal supervision. Background in Java, Python, and UML with a unique approach in software development methodologies.
